replicaCount.description: Number of UI pods. Must stay 1 while persistence.data or persistence.secrets uses a ReadWriteOnce volume, because two pods on different nodes cannot mount the same RWO claim. The chart fails the render if you raise this against RWO storage.

image.description: Container image for the LDAP Manager UI.

tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion when empty.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets for pulling from a private registry.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified release name.

serviceAccount.description: Service account. The UI needs no Kubernetes API access, so it is created but never granted RBAC.

annotations.description: Annotations, e.g. an IRSA or workload-identity role.

name.description: Existing ServiceAccount name. Used when create is false.

contextPath.description: Serve under a sub-path, e.g. /ldap-manager, when behind a proxy that does not strip the prefix.

allowedOrigins.description: Comma-separated CORS origins. Empty blocks cross-origin browser calls.

jsonLogs.description: Emit structured JSON logs instead of plain text.

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources for supplying credentials from Secrets or ConfigMaps.

config.description: The config.yml the UI reads. This is the only way clusters are defined - the application never writes it and has no runtime cluster or credential API.

existingConfigMap.description: Use an existing ConfigMap instead of the rendered one.

key.description: Key within the ConfigMap holding the config.

mountPath.description: Mount path for the config file.

content.description: Full config.yml as a string. Used when existingConfigMap is empty.

mode.description: none serves anonymous traffic at defaultRole; local and ldap require a login even for reads.

defaultRole.description: Role granted to anonymous requests in none mode. Not user-selectable, because choosing your own role would be privilege escalation.

ldap.description: LDAP authentication. Binds as the user's own DN, so no cluster-wide bind secret is needed to log in.

clusters.description: Clusters to manage. Each entry needs a name, bind_dn and either host or nodes.

extra.description: Extra YAML appended to the generated config.

secrets.description: Credentials. Supply cluster bind passwords via env or file - never inline in config.yml.

existingSecret.description: Use an existing Secret for credentials.

create.description: Render a Secret from the values below.

env.description: Environment variables sourced from a Secret.

mountPath.description: Mount path for mounted credential files.

persistence.description: State volumes. /app/.secrets holds the session signing key and local accounts, so its PVC carries helm.sh/resource-policy: keep - helm uninstall will not delete it.

data.description: Application data, including the audit log at /app/.data/audit.log.

enabled.description: Create an Ingress. Terminate TLS here; the UI itself speaks plain HTTP.

probes.description: Health probes against the app-local endpoint.

deploymentStrategy.description: Rollout strategy. Defaults to maxSurge 0 / maxUnavailable 1 so two pods never contend for the same RWO claim.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context. Runs as non-root by default.

resources.description: CPU and memory requests and limits.

maxUnavailable.description: Pods that may be unavailable during voluntary disruption.

accessModes.description: Access modes. ReadWriteMany is required only if you raise replicaCount above 1.

storageClass.description: StorageClass. Empty uses the cluster default.
